# OmniRevive-OS

> OmniRevive-OS is an autonomous AI-powered revenue recovery control plane for fintech payment failures and B2B dispute resolution. It features sub-50ms Fast-Loop autonomous gateway failover, Weibull hazard curve retry modeling, Deep-Loop neural voice agents, Redis Compare-And-Swap (CAS) distributed idempotency, AWS Cedar zero-trust security gatekeeping, and cryptographic SHA-256 Merkle audit ledgers.

## Key Capabilities & Core Architecture
- **Dual-Speed Control Plane**: Sub-50ms Fast-Loop for instant gateway failover & Smart Retries alongside Deep-Loop neural voice negotiation for enterprise B2B disputes.
- **Mathematical Determinism**: Weibull hazard rate survival modeling calibrated on NPCI UPI switch health telemetry.
- **Strict Idempotency**: Redis atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) distributed mutex preventing double-debit mutations.
- **Institutional Compliance**: TRAI quiet hours (9 PM - 9 AM IST) enforcement, RBI financial safety bounds, and AWS Cedar formal policy gatekeeper.
- **Tamper-Evident Audit Ledger**: Sequential SHA-256 Merkle hash chain for immutable regulatory verification.
